liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (2 reviews): Attendee recalls the 'Test Me' line in Bertha exploding, signaling a fun night ahead [12][19]
- **Let It Grow** (2 reviews): Jerome's playing on Let It Grow is singled out as ripping, enough to make the listener feel like spinning; Attendee, tripping, saw the backline amps and drums appear to spell out the band's name during Let It Grow [9][11]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Reviewer insists the Scarlet Begonias > Fire On The Mountain is far better than merely marginally inspired [16]
- **Space** (1 review): Around five minutes into Space, the band briefly touches the Wang Dang Doodle theme before returning to Space [13]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Bob stumbles the beginning of the Truckin' intro [13]
- **Wang Dang Doodle** (1 other source): Notes mark this show as the first performance of Wang Dang Doodle [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Wang Dang Doodle**: back after 654 archived shows (3594 days) [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-08-26.148832.fob.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1983-08-26.142901.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: audience recording; 21 songs; 167 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears this as a drastic improvement over the older archive copy, and sounding very nice; Sound is rough for the first minutes as the PA was dialed in; set one is distant, improving mid-Minglewood [2][17]
- **gd1983-08-26.142900.beyerm201.holbrook.flac1644**: audience recording; 21 songs; 167 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears this as a drastic improvement over the older archive copy, and sounding very nice [18]
- **gd1983-08-26.148833.fob.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds it clearer and more present than a master patched from the boomy Sennheisers [19]
- **gd83-08-26.sennheiser.dodd.12258.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the audience recording distant and a bit boomy, a modest quality rating; Average for an audience tape: deep bass, but the overall sound is somewhat distant [9][10]
- **gd1983-08-26.110903.Sennheiser421-daweez.D5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 155 min; rated 2.2/5 by 5 [6]. Said about its sound: Recording quality improves as the show goes on; reviewer found it good enough to burn to CD; Reviewer finds the recording decent but a bit boomy; Reviewer says this transfer is not boomy at all, but quite in-your-face [13][14][16]
- **gd1983-08-26.177542.2nd.set.unknown.bradt.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 11 songs; 94 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]

## Around the show

- Attendee stood at the back of the floor, on a folding metal chair, for most of the show [11]
- A very long pause between Woman Smarter and He's Gone, probably from equipment problems [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-08-26.148832.fob.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mini mics (mounted in hat, left side, 40' from stage)(Row A, Section 15, seats 4 & 5) > Sony D5M… [1]. Also: A six-second patch in Drums comes from Ernie Dodd's Sennheiser 421 source [1]
- **gd1983-08-26.142901.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Kyle Holbrook & Chris Kidwell; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: flac24/48khz ource Audience Recording: Beyer M 201c;1st gen TDK MA metal 90Location: set 1: 100 feet from stage|DFC set 2: 70 feet from stage|DFC [2]
- **gd1983-08-26.142900.beyerm201.holbrook.flac1644**: taped by Kyle Holbrook & Chris Kidwell; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: flac16/44.1khz ource Audience Recording: Beyer M 201c;1st gen TDK MA metal 90Location: set 1: 100 feet from stage|DFC set 2: 70 feet from stage|DFC [3]
- **gd1983-08-26.148833.fob.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mini mics (mounted in hat, left side, 40' from stage)(Row A, Section 15, seats 4 & 5) > Sony D5M… [4]
- **gd83-08-26.sennheiser.dodd.12258.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD (Senn. 421Âs)> MC >DAT>CDR [5]
- **gd1983-08-26.110903.Sennheiser421-daweez.D5scott.flac16**: taped by Daweez; transferred by D5scott; source: 2 Sennheiser 421 microphones > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes [6]
- **gd1983-08-26.177542.2nd.set.unknown.bradt.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Bill Bradt; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Audience Cassette; Unknown Equipment - from the Bill Bradt collection (Maxell MX-90) [7]. Also: A 4:09 patch in the Drums > Space transition combines Severson's Nakamichi 700 and Dodd's Sennheiser 421 sources [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1983-08-26 Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1983-08-26-ticket/) [22]
- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [1983-08-26 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1983-08-26-backstage-pass/) [23]
